mgmt_bio.text: Carlo Messina, born in Rome in 1962, has been Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Intesa Sanpaolo since 29 September 2013. A graduate in Economics and Business from Luiss University in Rome, he began his career at Banca Nazionale del Lavoro in corporate finance and primary markets, was head of planning at Banco Ambrosiano Veneto from 1996, and in 2002 became head of the planning and control department at Banca Intesa. At Intesa Sanpaolo he led the Value Creation Governance Area in 2007, became Chief Financial Officer in 2008, General Manager and CFO in 2012, and in 2013 also headed the Banca dei Territori Division before his appointment as CEO. Since April 2016, under the group's one-tier governance system, he has served as Managing Director and CEO, General Manager and sole executive Board Director.

thesis_pillars.text: Intesa Sanpaolo targets a sustainable return on equity above 20% under a 2026-2029 business plan described as tech- and fee-driven, zero-NPL and leader in wealth management, protection and advisory. The plan envisages capital returns of around 50 billion euro over 2025-2029, with a 75% cash dividend payout ratio and buybacks of about 20% of distributions. Capital is expected to stay comfortably above the 12.5% CET1 target through the plan.
